WITH channel_agg AS (
  SELECT channel, id,
         SUM(sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(return_amt) AS returns,
         SUM(profit) - SUM(net_loss) AS profit
  FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
           ss_net_profit AS profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS return_amt,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS net_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'store channel', 'store' || s_store_id,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           sr_return_amt,
           sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN store ON store_returns.sr_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel', 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id,
           cs_ext_sales_price,
           cs_net_profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel', 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           cr_return_amount,
           cr_net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN catalog_page ON catalog_returns.cr_catalog_page_sk = catalog_page.cp_catalog_page_sk
    WHERE catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel', 'web_site' || web_site_id,
           ws_ext_sales_price,
           ws_net_profit,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2))
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel', 'web_site' || web_site_id,
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)),
           wr_return_amt,
           wr_net_loss
    FROM web_returns
    LEFT JOIN web_sales ON web_returns.wr_item_sk = web_sales.ws_item_sk AND web_returns.wr_order_number = web_sales.ws_order_number
    JOIN web_site ON web_sales.ws_web_site_sk = web_site.web_site_sk
    WHERE web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk IN (
      SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
    )
  ) AS all_facts
  GROUP BY channel, id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM channel_agg
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
